user.title: Connect to LinkTap gateway
user.description: Enter the IP address or hostname of your LinkTap gateway. Provide a username and password only if you have enabled access control on the gateway.

zeroconf_confirm.title: Add discovered LinkTap gateway
zeroconf_confirm.description: Do you want to add the LinkTap gateway {gw_id} at {host}?

reauth_confirm.title: Re-authenticate LinkTap gateway
reauth_confirm.description: The gateway at {host} rejected the stored credentials. Enter the current username and password.

error.cannot_connect: Failed to connect to the gateway. Check the host and that the Local HTTP API is enabled.

abort.not_linktap: Discovered device is not a LinkTap gateway.

data.poll_interval: Poll interval while push is healthy (seconds)
data.active_poll_interval: Poll interval when push is unreachable (seconds)
data.vol_unit: Volume unit override (leave blank to use the gateway's setting)

start_watering.name: Start watering
start_watering.description: Start instant watering for a duration, with an optional volume limit (flow-meter devices only).

seconds.name: Duration
seconds.description: How long to water, in seconds.

volume.name: Volume limit
volume.description: Optional volume limit; watering stops when reached (flow-meter devices only).

pause.name: Pause watering plan
pause.description: Pause the watering plan for a number of hours. Use 0 to unpause.

hours.name: Hours
hours.description: Number of hours to pause; 0 unpauses.

dismiss_alert.name: Dismiss alert
dismiss_alert.description: Dismiss the alert represented by the selected binary sensor.

dismiss_alerts.name: Dismiss all alerts
dismiss_alerts.description: Dismiss all alerts for the device of the selected binary sensor.
